## Change

Describe the API, algorithm, proof, or documentation change and its scope.

## Evidence

- [ ] Full Lean build and axiom audit pass.
- [ ] Numerical reference checks and the external-client check pass.
- [ ] Documentation builds; source links and verification scope are current.
- [ ] CHANGELOG records user-visible changes and compatibility impacts.

State which claims are proved, which are numerically tested, and any remaining limitations.
